asm.asm:
# r1 = input. amount (u64) at [r1+0]
ldxdw r2, [r1+0]
lddw r3, 1000000000      # the $1B cap
jgt r2, r3, over_cap
mov64 r0, 0              # success
exit
over_cap:
mov64 r0, 1              # custom error: amount over cap
exit

ldxdw r3, [r1+8]         # N
loop:
jeq r3, 0, done
ldxdw r2, [r1+0]         # read counter
add64 r2, 1
stxdw [r1+0], r2         # write it back
sub64 r3, 1
ja loop
done:
ldxdw r0, [r1+0]
exit

ldxdw r3, [r1+0]         # n
mov64 r0, 0
mov64 r2, 1
loop:
jeq r3, 0, done
mov64 r4, r0
add64 r4, r2
mov64 r0, r2
mov64 r2, r4
sub64 r3, 1
ja loop
done:
exit

ldxdw r3, [r1+0]         # n
mov64 r0, 1
mov64 r2, 1              # i
loop:
jgt r2, r3, done
mov64 r4, r0
mul64 r4, r2
mov64 r5, r4
div64 r5, r2
jne r5, r0, overflow     # (r0*i)/i != r0 means it wrapped
mov64 r0, r4
add64 r2, 1
ja loop
done:
exit
overflow:
mov64 r0, 2              # custom error: overflow
exit

ldxdw r2, [r1+0]
ldxdw r3, [r1+8]
loop:
jeq r3, 0, done
mov64 r4, r2
mod64 r4, r3
mov64 r2, r3
mov64 r3, r4
ja loop
done:
mov64 r0, r2
exit

ldxdw r2, [r1+0]         # n
mov64 r0, 0
jlt r2, 2, done
mov64 r0, 1
jlt r2, 4, done
mov64 r4, r2
and64 r4, 1
jeq r4, 0, composite
mov64 r3, 3              # divisor
loop:
mov64 r4, r3
mul64 r4, r3
jgt r4, r2, done         # d*d > n: prime
mov64 r4, r2
mod64 r4, r3
jeq r4, 0, composite
add64 r3, 2
ja loop
composite:
mov64 r0, 0
done:
exit

ldxdw r2, [r1+0]         # from balance
ldxdw r3, [r1+8]         # to balance
ldxdw r4, [r1+16]        # amount
jgt r4, r2, insufficient
mov64 r5, r3
add64 r5, r4
jlt r5, r3, overflow
sub64 r2, r4
stxdw [r1+0], r2
stxdw [r1+8], r5
mov64 r0, 0
exit
insufficient:
mov64 r0, 1
exit
overflow:
mov64 r0, 2
exit

ldxdw r2, [r1+0]         # balance
ldxdw r3, [r1+8]         # withdrawn today
ldxdw r4, [r1+16]        # daily limit
ldxdw r5, [r1+24]        # request
jgt r5, r2, over_balance
mov64 r6, r3
add64 r6, r5
jgt r6, r4, over_limit
sub64 r2, r5
stxdw [r1+0], r2
stxdw [r1+8], r6
mov64 r0, 0
exit
over_balance:
mov64 r0, 1
exit
over_limit:
mov64 r0, 2
exit

ldxdw r6, [r1+8]         # number of votes
mov64 r7, r1
add64 r7, 16             # cursor
mov64 r8, 0              # voted bitmap
loop:
jeq r6, 0, done
ldxb r2, [r7+0]          # voter id
ldxb r3, [r7+1]          # choice
mov64 r4, 1
lsh64 r4, r2
jset r8, r4, double_vote
or64 r8, r4
lsh64 r3, 3              # choice * 8
add64 r3, r1
ldxdw r5, [r3+64]
add64 r5, 1
stxdw [r3+64], r5
add64 r7, 2
sub64 r6, 1
ja loop
done:
mov64 r0, 0
exit
double_vote:
mov64 r0, 3
exit

ldxdw r2, [r1+0]         # escrowed amount
ldxdw r3, [r1+8]         # deadline slot
ldxdw r4, [r1+16]        # current slot
ldxdw r5, [r1+24]        # delivered flag
jeq r2, 0, empty
jeq r5, 1, release
jgt r4, r3, refund
mov64 r0, 4              # condition not met yet
exit
release:
stxdw [r1+32], r2        # seller receives
ja clear
refund:
stxdw [r1+40], r2        # buyer refunded
clear:
stdw [r1+0], 0
mov64 r0, 0
exit
empty:
mov64 r0, 5
exit
